shared_elements: shallow low-relief carving on a coarse grey/brown stone monolith
upright rectangular block with a flat carved face
curved paired lines suggesting arms or crescents
band of relief motifs across the upper part of the surface
justification: Both are massive, coarse-grained upright stone blocks whose flat faces bear shallow, pecked low relief, and both include ring/disc forms and paired curving lines that read as arms or crescents set above a broadly bare lower field. The correspondence stops there: A's relief is a single sprawling zoomorphic figure on an architectural T-shaped pillar still in the ground, whereas B is a shaped anthropomorphic statue with a head and shoulders and a tightly packed symmetrical arrangement of discrete emblems, displayed indoors.
